description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Zay Flowers practiced on Wednesday.
items.impact: Flowers returned from a hamstring injury last week. It appears he didn't suffer any setbacks in his return.
items.title: Zay Flowers (hamstring) practices Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Ronnie Stanley was back at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Stanley was sidelined last week for the Ravens. His presence at practice is a positive sign for his return this week.
items.title: Ronnie Stanley (toe) returns to practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Trey Hendrickson is not practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: Hendrickson continues to play through a finger injury. His status will need to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.
items.title: Trey Hendrickson (finger) not practicing Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Lamar Jackson was not present at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: It is unclear what the reason why is. Jackson's status will need to be monitored when the injury report is released.
items.title: Lamar Jackson not practicing Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Kenyon Sadiq will be limited in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Sadiq is coming off a career best performance this past week. He should remain in a bigger role if Adonai Mitchell (finger) misses another game.
items.title: Kenyon Sadiq to be limited in practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Tyjae Spears is not practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: Spears and Tony Pollard will both be sidelined from practice to begin the week. They'll need to be monitored in practice on Thursday ahead of Week 4 against the Ravens.
items.title: Tyjae Spears not practicing Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Tony Pollard is not practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: Pollard and Tyjae Spears will both be sidelined from practice to begin the week. They'll need to be monitored in practice on Thursday ahead of Week 4 against the Ravens.
items.title: Tony Pollard will not practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jets head coach Aaron Glenn said there's a "good chance" Minkah Fitzpatrick plays on Sunday.
items.impact: Fitzpatrick should return to practice this week. His status will need to be monitored on the injury report.
items.title: Minkah Fitzpatrick (groin) expected to return in Week 4

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Dylan Parham will not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Parham is considered week-to-week.
items.title: Dylan Parham not practicing Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Adonai Mitchell will remain sidelined from practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Jets head coach Aaron Glenn said Mitchell is considered week-to-week. He is likely to sit this Sunday.
items.title: Adonai Mitchell (finger) not practicing Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Breece Hall will be sidelined from practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Jets head coach Aaron Glenn said Hall is considered week-to-week. He is likely to sit this Sunday.
items.title: Breece Hall (quad) not practicing Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Mason Taylor will remain sidelined from practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Jets head coach Aaron Glenn said Taylor is considered week-to-week. He is likely to sit this Sunday.
items.title: Mason Taylor (thumb) not practicing Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jaylen Wright was limited during practice Wednesday.
items.impact: Wright was sidelined last week. When he is healthy, he'll figure to step into a committee with Ollie Gordon with De'Von Achane (knee) out for the season.
items.title: Jaylen Wright (foot) limited in practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Caleb Douglas did not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Douglas did not play last week and he seems likely to miss another game. Malik Washington and Chris Bell would continue to see more run.
items.title: Caleb Douglas (ankle) misses practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Panthers placed CB Jaycee Horn on injured reserve.
items.impact: Horn suffered a quad tear in Week 3's loss to Cleveland. He could miss most of the season.
items.title: Jaycee Horn (quad) placed on IR

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Panthers placed CB Mike Jackson Sr. on injured reserve.
items.impact: Jackson will miss at least the next four weeks with a groin injury.
items.title: Mike Jackson Sr. (groin) placed on IR

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Commanders head coach Dan Quinn said Rachaad White is receiving treatment for his shoulder injury.
items.impact: It is unclear if it will impact the status of White heading into Week 4. Jacory Croskey-Merritt could see more work with Austin Ekeler still uncertain to make his Commanders debut.
items.title: Rachaad White receiving treatment for shoulder injury

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Commanders head coach Dan Quinn said Jayden Daniels will be limited in Wednesday's practice.
items.impact: Daniels will practice in some fashion this week. He remains unlikely to return this Sunday.
items.title: Jayden Daniels (elbow) to be limited in practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Josh Simmons is expected to remain sidelined from practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Simmons is continuing to work his way back from a back injury. He is expected to be the lone player not to practice for Kansas City.
items.title: Josh Simmons (back) not practicing Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Texans released Bryce Oliver from their practice squad.
items.impact: Oliver will seek another opportunity.
items.title: Bryce Oliver released by Texans

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Texans signed WR Treyvhon Saunders to their practice squad.
items.impact: Saunders will add depth in the wide receiver room for Houston.
items.title: Treyvhon Saunders signs with Texans

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Texans signed LB Caleb Johnson to their practice squad.
items.impact: Johnson will add depth in the linebacker room for Houston.
items.title: Caleb Johnson signs with Texans

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Texans signed DL Aaron Graves to their practice squad.
items.impact: Graves will add depth on the defensive line for Houston.
items.title: Aaron Graves signs with Texans

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Texans signed DE Chris Braswell to their 53-man roster.
items.impact: Braswell will add depth on the defensive line for Houston.
items.title: Chris Braswell signs with Texans' 53-man roster

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Texans placed Mario Edwards Jr. on injured reserve.
items.impact: Edwards is expected to be out for the season with a torn ACL.
items.title: Mario Edwards Jr. (knee) placed on IR
